definitions.explanation: The act of dividing something into smaller, more manageable portions. Commonly used when packaging food or organizing items into smaller groups.

examples.japanese: お{菓子|かし}を{小分|こわ}けにして{配|くば}った。
examples.english: I divided the sweets into small portions and handed them out.

examples.japanese: {残|のこ}ったカレーを{小分|こわ}けにして{冷凍|れいとう}した。
examples.english: I divided the leftover curry into small portions and froze them.

notes: Most commonly used in the pattern {小分|こわ}けにする. Frequently appears in cooking and food storage contexts. Collocations: {小分|こわ}けにする (to divide into portions), {小分|こわ}けパック (individual portion pack), {小分|こわ}け{袋|ぶくろ} (small bag for portioning).
